Author: Jackoltrade
Name: PS5 DualSense Controller for FFXIV
Description: Custom USB DualSense lighting, character combat haptics and an optional native footstep vibration amplifier. Limit Break bottom LEDs show ready bars, partial PvP charge and your LB cast/use. Spatial combat direction is character-centered and camera-aligned. Native footsteps can be boosted independently while unmounted; mount, speaker and trigger effects are preserved. Added feedback pauses and custom lights turn off when FFXIV loses focus.
Punchline: Custom DualSense lighting and character combat haptics.
